test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Advanced Full Test - 02
subject: general
question: According to the Stanford AI Index Report 2025, what is India’s annual AI talent hiring growth rate, and what is its rank in the Global AI Vibrancy Tool?

options.text: About 25% annual hiring growth and ranks among the top five globally
About 33% annual hiring growth and ranks among the top three globally
About 40% annual hiring growth and ranks among the top ten globally
About 50% annual hiring growth and ranks among the top two globally

solution:
The correct answer is __**About 33% annual hiring growth and ranks among the top three globally.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**
